description: This Java class implements a composite pattern for connectivity command interceptors, allowing multiple interceptors to be applied to connectivity commands in sequence.

classes.name: CompoundConnectivityCommandInterceptor
classes.description: A final class that implements ConnectivityCommandInterceptor, allowing multiple interceptors to be chained and executed.

methods.name: CompoundConnectivityCommandInterceptor
methods.description: Constructor that accepts varargs of ConnectivityCommandInterceptor and stores them in a list.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Executes accept method of each stored ConnectivityCommandInterceptor on a given command and connection supplier.
